outcome.technical: P148-R22 (fixed): the duplicated same-file comparison (_doctor_policy._same_file, _panel_write._one_file) is deleted from both; one definition, _skill_places.same_file, is reached by both through the new _skill_places.loaded_verdict(entry, hit), which returns the travel verdict for the copy a session loads ({travels, basis, graded: scan|tier}, or None when neither the scan nor the resolver knows a copy). Case dp57 wraps _skill_places.same_file with a recorder and shows doctor and the panel each call it, and that neither module still defines its own copy. P148-R23 (fixed): the unresolved-skills warning in _manifest_typos._check_skills now names the plan-level exit - 'set a plan default in meta.defaultSkills (audit-task.py default-skills)' - and says what it consulted at the plan level ('no plan default', or 'plan default names no usable skill' when the key is present but resolves nothing); docstring updated to list every level. SKILLS_BODY in tests/test__warning_groups.py changed in the same edit (wg2 pins it byte for byte); new wg19 counts each exit exactly once in the line the validator really produces and checks both plan-level wordings. The other half of the original finding (_skills_in_use ignoring meta.defaultSkills) was already fixed at HEAD: _manifest_typos.py _skills_in_use reads meta.defaultSkills first. P148-R29 (fixed): _panel_write._reject_stranded now grades the resolved file instead of accepting on any mismatch - when the resolver finds a copy the scan did not grade (another path, or not listed at all), loaded_verdict grades it by tier: personal never travels (refused under strict, basis naming the loaded path), project and the running plugin's own travel, mirroring _panel_discovery.grade_entry for the same tiers (pinned by sp20).
